columns.name: TimeGenerated
columns.description: Event time when it is within the ingestion window, otherwise ingestion time.

columns.name: EventTime
columns.description: Time of the audit event as recorded by Databricks.

columns.name: SchemaVersion
columns.description: Databricks audit log schema version.

columns.name: AuditLevel
columns.description: ACCOUNT_LEVEL or WORKSPACE_LEVEL.

columns.name: AccountId
columns.description: Databricks account ID.

columns.name: OrgId
columns.description: Databricks workspace (organisation) ID; 0 for account-level events.

columns.name: WorkspaceId
columns.description: Workspace ID the event belongs to.

columns.name: ShardName
columns.description: Databricks shard (deployment) name.

columns.name: ServiceName
columns.description: Databricks service that emitted the event, for example accounts, clusters, secrets, unityCatalog.

columns.name: ActionName
columns.description: Action within the service, for example login, createCluster, getSecret.

columns.name: RequestId
columns.description: Unique request ID.

columns.name: SessionId
columns.description: Session ID.

columns.name: SourceIPAddress
columns.description: Source IP address of the request.

columns.name: UserAgent
columns.description: User agent of the request.

columns.name: UserEmail
columns.description: Email of the user or service principal that made the request.

columns.name: UserSubjectName
columns.description: Subject name from the identity.

columns.name: UserIdentity
columns.description: Full userIdentity object.

columns.name: RequestParams
columns.description: Request parameters as delivered by Databricks.

columns.name: ResponseStatusCode
columns.description: HTTP status code of the response.

columns.name: ResponseErrorMessage
columns.description: Error message when the request failed.

columns.name: ResponseResult
columns.description: Response result object.

columns.name: S3Bucket
columns.description: Reserved; populated by the Azure Function option only.

columns.name: S3Key
columns.description: Reserved; populated by the Azure Function option only.
